default.title: GPU installation requires a manual PyTorch setup.
default.text: For GPU support, install the CUDA-enabled version of PyTorch first. The correct PyTorch command depends on your operating system, CUDA version, GPU model, and installed drivers.
default.small_text: After installing the GPU-enabled PyTorch backend, run the MEYELens command shown below.

default.title: Headless installation comes without the GUI.
default.text: This is useful for minimal systems, remote devices, servers, and embedded hardware such as NVIDIA Jetson.
default.small_text: On NVIDIA Jetson, install the appropriate GPU-enabled PyTorch package manually before running MEYELens.

default.title: This installation runs on CPU
default.small_text: You are installing the CPU version of MEYELens. This version is compatible with systems without a supported GPU, but it is slower than the GPU version. For faster performance, select the GPU installation option.
